create_popart_factory: create a PopArt factory with popart(num_outputs, step_size, scale_lb, scale_ub) returning initial state and update functions
normalize_targets: normalize unnormalized targets using PopArt state and indices to produce normalized values
unnormalize_targets: unnormalize PopArt-normalized values back to original scale using state and indices
update_popart_state: update PopArt state and linear parameters adaptively with art() using targets, indices, and step size
preserve_linear_outputs: preserve linear layer outputs precisely when PopArt state changes using pop(params, old_state, new_state)
